annotations.title: List Argentine events in a city

description: Upcoming Argentine events in a city abroad (concerts, peñas, folk and tango nights, theatre, comedy, talks, football screenings, festivals), with local time and Buenos Aires time, venue and address, and the Argento page of each event. Filter with a date range. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it); event titles come as published.

city.description: The city: its slug from list_cities (madrid, new-york…), its name in Spanish, English or Italian (Madrid, New York, London, Londra…) or one of its airport codes (MAD, JFK).

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD, city time). Default: today in the city.

lang.description: Language of the labels and of the text summary: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

name: list_events
title: List Argentine events in a city
